name: Soy Supremacy
source:
Welcome to the brand new world of Soy Supremacy !

By day: Serve bland, approved meals under the watchful eye of Officer Slayla. Profit margins? Almost non-existent.

By night: Your cafe transforms. Beneath the counter you have juicy steaks. greasy burgers and soda with a real sugar. And Babe, your lovely childhood friends, love it all! 

You definitely need some help! And Bunny will help you. In return... you'll have to make her happy.

What does the future look like? How will you manage those three women?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833120/Soy_Supremacy/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到大豆霸权的全新世界！

白天：在斯莱拉警官的监督下提供清淡、经批准的膳食。利润率？几乎不存在。

到了晚上：你的咖啡馆就会发生变化。柜台下面有多汁的牛排。油腻的汉堡和加了真正糖的苏打水。宝贝，你可爱的儿时朋友，都喜欢这一切！

你绝对需要一些帮助！兔子会帮助你。作为回报……你必须让她开心。

未来是什么样子？你将如何管理这三个女人？

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833120/Soy_Supremacy/]Steam[/url]]
